title: Iterative magnitude pruning reduces DF model parameters from 3,981,476 to 816,088 with comparable accuracy on Walkie-Talkie defense
content: Applying iterative magnitude pruning to the Deep Fingerprinting (DF) model for the Walkie–Talkie defense scenario reduces the number of trainable parameters from 3,981,476 to 816,088 after 9 pruning rounds, while maintaining the classification accuracy at approximately 49% (original unpruned accuracy: 49.7%). This indicates that the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis can be used to find a smaller subnetwork of the DF model that achieves comparable performance.
